Master Keys Lexicon L14.12

About this page
Lexicon edition L14.12 (its own number: whole numbers for page changes, decimals for word and clue changes only). Every answer and clue in Master Keys v13b (CrossKeys and LockWord; formerly Clue Duel and Word Vault), built 2026-11-24 [14:44 UT].
Word Level (1–5) is how hard the word is (1 everyday … 5 obscure). Challenge Limit optionally limits a clue set to some Challenge Levels ("7" = 7 and up, "2-4" = 2 to 4). Plays at shows the Challenge Levels (1–10) where the word can appear, worked out from the two.
Click a heading to sort; drag a heading to move its column; drag the bar at its right edge to resize (double-click the bar to reset). Search: ? = any one letter, * = any letters, "quotes" = whole word only. ? Missing-letter clues shows only clues with a missing letter (orange ?) or word (orange bar); when editing, type _ for a missing letter and ___ for a missing word. A 1-letter answer holds one clue per row (no ";").

✏️ Edit Mode: change clues, Word Level, Challenge Limit, Status and Comments; ➕ Add word; then 📋 Copy Edits and paste them into the chat with Claude. Edited cells are blue; added words are violet until Claude checks them; bright red rows are INVALID words. Edits are kept in this browser until Claude has applied them.

Your edit record (L12): every edit Claude applies is kept for good. Edited rows show ✎; Edits counts them (click for each change, old → new, with its time); Last edit (UT) sorts by date; ✎ Edited by JM lists them. Tick Reviewed (Edit Mode) on rows you have checked, changed or not; the Kind menu filters Reviewed and Not reviewed yet. Copy Edits shows the time of each edit.
Clue kinds (the three-kind test, CD-67): Literal = what the word means (definitions, synonyms); Indirect = what the word is linked to (descriptions, examples, associations, sayings, fill-in blanks), used more as the Challenge Level rises; Wordplay = a trick in the clue's own words (double meaning, pun, sound-alike, misdirection), marked with "?", used from Challenge Level 5. Length: each clue choice 14 characters ideal, 20 at most; Longest clue and the Clue length filter find the wordy ones.

Lexicon L13: 📝 Claude drafts show in purple and are not in the game. In Edit Mode, tap the Draft button to switch: — undecided → ✓ Accept (green) → ✗ Reject → — undecided. Your own edits always win over a draft, and Reviewed stays your own progress tick. ↵ / ⋯ in a clue or Comments heading switches that column between full view and one-line view (Wrap all / Clip all does them all). Edits left from an earlier edition show in a yellow bar, with Clear leftovers.
Edition numbers (CD-67: 4.4.2): a whole number (L13, L14) when this page's structure changes; a decimal (L13.01, L13.02) when only the words and clues change. A new edition holds every edit you sent that Claude applied: that is how you know it is in the game.

➕ Add a word

Fill in what you like: Claude checks the word and completes the rest after you Copy Edits. The page checks the spelling rules right away.
